name: STARK / MixFormer (Yan et al. ICCV 2021; Cui et al. CVPR 2022) - template update gated by a reliability score
bibliography: (1) Bin Yan, Houwen Peng, Jianlong Fu, Dong Wang, Huchuan Lu. Learning Spatio-Temporal Transformer for Visual Tracking. ICCV 2021; preprint arXiv:2103.17154 (31 Mar 2021) - preprint and ICCV paper are the same study. Code: https://github.com/researchmm/Stark. (2) Yutao Cui, Cheng Jiang, Limin Wang, Gangshan Wu. MixFormer: End-to-End Tracking with Iterative Mixed Attention. CVPR 2022; preprint arXiv:2203.11082 - same study; a later journal extension exists [uncertain]. Code: https://github.com/MCG-NJU/MixFormer.
full_text_checked: Short screening: arXiv full text (ar5iv HTML) of both read for score head / score prediction module, training stages, update rule, ablation tables (STARK Tables 5-7; MixFormer Tables 5-6) and main results. Code not inspected; supplementary not read.
task_and_output: Single-object tracking; output bounding box via corner heads, plus a scalar reliability/confidence score (sigmoid) used only to decide whether to replace the dynamic (online) template.
data_and_independent_videos: Trained on LaSOT, GOT-10k, TrackingNet, COCO train splits; evaluated on standard test splits (LaSOT 280 videos, GOT-10k test, TrackingNet test, VOT2020, VOT2020-LT for STARK, UAV123 for MixFormer). Test videos unseen.
target_size_and_input_resolution: Template 128x128, search 320x320 (both papers); search area about 5x5 target size (STARK, text partly garbled). Backbone ResNet-50/101 stride 16 (STARK) or mixed-attention ViT (MixFormer).
frame_rate_and_camera_motion: Benchmark native frame rates; template update interval 200 frames in both; camera motion not modeled.
detector_and_exemplar: No detector. Exemplar = initial template + one dynamic template (STARK) or N online templates (MixFormer) cropped from frames that passed the score check.
trainable_nodes_and_loss: Two-stage training. Stage 1: backbone + transformer + corner head, 500 epochs, L1 + GIoU, all search images contain the target. Stage 2: only the score head (STARK: 3-layer MLP, 50 epochs, BCE) or score prediction module (MixFormer: score token with 2 attention blocks + 3-layer MLP, 40 epochs, cross-entropy) trained, everything else frozen; roughly half of the search regions contain the target. STARK-ST50 23.5M params total.
controls_seeds_splits: Matched ablations: STARK-S (no temporal template) vs STARK-ST; 'w/o score head' (update every interval without check) in STARK Table 6; joint one-stage training (Table 7); MixFormer Table 6: online templates with/without SPM and no online templates. Single runs, no seeds, no confidence intervals.
metrics_and_numbers: STARK (arXiv 2103.17154): Table 6 LaSOT success, STARK-ST50 full 66.4; w/o score head 64.5 (below STARK-S50, which uses no dynamic template; S50 about 65.8 derived from text); w/o encoder 61.1; Table 7: updating query embedding instead 64.8, joint one-stage localization+classification training 62.5. GOT-10k AO S50 67.2 / ST50 68.0 / ST101 68.8 (Table 1); TrackingNet AUC 80.3 / 81.3 / 82.0 (Table 2); VOT2020-LT F-score 70.2 (ST50) (Table 4); FPS 41.8 ST50 (Table 5). MixFormer (arXiv 2203.11082): Table 6 LaSOT AUC - online templates without SPM 66.6, with SPM 69.2, no online templates 68.1; main LaSOT AUC MixFormer-L 70.1, MixFormer-22k 69.2; TrackingNet 83.9 (L); GOT-10k AO 75.6 (L); 25 FPS (1080Ti).
tested_conditions: Unseen videos: yes. Target absence: STARK partly (VOT2020-LT with disappearance, presence via score; no refusal metric beyond F-score); MixFormer not reported. Similar distractors: not reported quantitatively (STARK attention maps qualitative). Occlusion: not separately reported. Night/low light: not reported. Sequential operation on own predictions: yes (online, causal).
mechanism_summary: Published: a separately trained binary reliability head predicts whether the current predicted box contains the target reliably; every 200 frames the dynamic template is replaced only if score > 0.5 (STARK) or by the highest-scoring frame in the interval (MixFormer). The key ablation shows unfiltered template updates are harmful (STARK 66.4 -> 64.5, below the no-update model; MixFormer 69.2 -> 66.6, below no online templates 68.1). Proposed (ours): none beyond what was tried - a learned reliability head over FlyVis readout outputs gating exemplar updates.
transfer_limits: Updates every 200 frames on long sequences, whereas our loss episodes last up to about 30 frames with 4 exemplar observations - there is essentially one exemplar and nothing to update. The score head operates on rich transformer features of the box region; our analogue (utility heads on 8-14 map/geometry statistics) failed. The score is a presence/quality classifier, not a distractor discriminator; with similar neighbours in a crop twice the target size it does not address which candidate is the old object. No link to MOT association.
research_questions_addressed: 5.1: caution - learned presence score separate from the map, but trained as target-present vs absent, not target vs similar distractor. 5.2: direct evidence that unchecked exemplar updates hurt and a quality gate is needed (both papers' ablations). 5.3: caution - the score head is trained after freezing the representation; joint training hurt in STARK (62.5 vs 66.4), relevant to our core training through the readout. 5.4: not addressed.
candidate_node_change: Not applicable as a new change: the equivalent (learned utility/reliability head over FlyVis map and geometry features) was tested in z13_map_utility_v1 and z13_next_utility_v1 and did not pass. A reliability head would only be worth re-testing if trained on FlyVis activity in the crop (not on summary statistics) with a target-vs-neighbour label; that belongs to N01/N16 designs, not this source.
strongest_objection: The mechanism solves 'when to update a template over hundreds of frames', which is not our problem (choose the old object or refuse within a short loss episode); the head relies on large-backbone features, and our nearest analogue already failed with 2 useful of 84 selected interventions (z13_balanced_ridge_v1 / utility cards).
evidence_strength: Peer-reviewed (ICCV 2021, CVPR 2022), code public (not inspected here), widely reproduced as baselines. Strong for the claim 'unfiltered template updates hurt on RGB benchmarks'; weak for transfer to our setting.
where_distinction_is_made: In a separate decision: a learned reliability head after the localization head; the map/corner maximum is never taken as presence - presence is a separate classifier. No separation of 'similar distractor' vs 'target' or 'outside search area' vs 'insufficient data'; all are 'unreliable'.
feature_dependence: Depends on rich RGB appearance features from ResNet/ViT transformers (score token attends to search ROI tokens). No evidence for small motion/brightness features.
association_consequence: Not applicable (single-object trackers; no detection matching). In our setting a reliability gate on corrections would be comparable to an external cost check rule.
difference_from_tried: No substantial difference: our utility heads on map statistics and geometry (z13_map_utility_v1, z13_next_utility_v1) and absolute confidence (z13_absolute_confidence_v1) already implement a learned or fixed reliability gate on the applied correction. The only differences are the features fed to the head (transformer tokens vs our 8-14 statistics) and that STARK/MixFormer gate template updates rather than position corrections. Remains an explanatory source, not grounds to repeat the experiment.
memory_write_policy: Dynamic template written every 200 frames only if score > 0.5 (STARK); MixFormer keeps the highest-scored frame in each 200-frame interval.
distractor_representation: Implicit only (via training loss); no distractor buffer.
refusal_evidence_horizon: Single frame score (MixFormer: maximum over an interval for update selection).
loss_on_applied_decision: On an intermediate presence/reliability label (BCE), not on the outcome of the template-update decision.
association_entry_point: Not applicable (no association in sources); if transferred: state update (exemplar replacement).
no_fly_control_equivalent: Not applicable as a new control; existing no-fly controls (geometry-only utility arms, Kalman selection) cover it.
hard_subset_evaluation: Not applicable / not reported (no DiDi, DanceTrack or MOSE evaluation).
temporal_information_availability: Causal: uses current and past frames; the update decision is available immediately (STARK) or at the end of each 200-frame interval (MixFormer selects the best frame within the interval, i.e. the template is applied up to 200 frames later).
depth_level: Short screening. Loses: the gate is a reliability classifier for long-horizon template updates, equivalent to our already failed utility heads; does not address choosing the old object among similar neighbours. Should not move to full analysis; cite as evidence that unchecked exemplar updates hurt and that joint training of the reliability head with localization was worse.
